heuristics.name: random-mapping-walk
heuristics.statement: The r-adding walk's collision statistics match uniform random sampling for the birthday bound.
heuristics.support: Pollard 1978; Teske 1998/2001 analysis and EC experiments; toy-curve experiments in experiment.py confirm the birthday curve quantitatively.

limitations: Analytic construction; no full-size execution or independent qualification.
Success relies on the supported random-mapping heuristic for the r-adding walk.
Instruction budgets are conservative analytic upper bounds, not measured assembly.
Beats the generic BSGS control via negligible-memory rho at the 0.39 threshold; not novel cryptanalysis.
